concepts.name: Pearl
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished high-fidelity desktop website screenshot for ORBIT AERIALS. Landscape canvas 1536x1152; the flat website fills the image, no browser frame, device, perspective board or outside labels. This is a focused refinement of the attached approved reference, not an unrelated redesign. Preserve the company's construction progress documentation, aerial mapping, spatial intelligence, 360 walkthrough and handover-media identity. Match the approved reference's design quality and improve typographic discipline, contrast, alignment and useful whitespace. All text sharp, legible and spelled exactly. No fabricated metrics, live state, testimonials, clients or technical accuracy claims. No drone hardware render. Use the existing typographic brand wording, do not invent a symbol. The models are illustrative visual assets, not a real software interface. The image should show the header, a complete hero, and a meaningful glimpse of the following content section, all composed intentionally.
VARIANT: SPATIAL PEARL. Refine the reference's white minimal presentation with the SAME signature isometric construction-site model, part photographic texture and part delicate point cloud. Preserve the essential shape and content of the model as closely as possible: pale site block, buildings, small crane, roads, palms, textured left and dissolving point-cloud right. No surrounding landscape photograph or image box.

Cool pearl-white #F7F8F9 surface everywhere, charcoal #202329 headings, medium grey body and restrained saturated cobalt #175BEC button. Elegant light/regular geometric sans-serif, generous clean whitespace, zero decorative gradients. Header height 85px: 'ORBIT AERIALS' left, quiet centered capsule 'Services  About  Contact', 'Log In' right. Centered headline at y145, around 66px in two lines 'Your entire site.' / 'In perspective.' Small centered subline 'Aerial documentation. Spatial understanding.' Below, one small cobalt capsule 'Explore our services'. Text occupies less than 300px in height, not oversized.

The hero model is centered under the heading, around 1160px wide and 475px high, sharply detailed and softly grounded on the pearl surface. Slight shadow is very delicate. Preserve clean breathing room around it. Hero ends around y880.
Below a subtle full-width divider, the next section at y940 is a carefully spaced asymmetrical row: left 40% reads 'Clarity, from capture' / 'to handover.' in 34px medium sans. Right 60% has two quiet text columns with small exact headings 'Document progress' and 'Explore your site', and one-line descriptions 'Consistent aerial records across your build.' and 'Mapping and 360 walkthroughs for clear context.' They are on the open page, no cards or borders around text. One button shape scale throughout. Calm, expensive, extremely precise. This is the refined light baseline for a paired dark-mode concept.
